name: Long Parameter List
description: A method that accepts more than three or four parameters, making it hard to understand, use, and maintain.

refactoringTechniques.name: Introduce Parameter Object
refactoringTechniques.description: Group parameters that naturally belong together into a single object.

refactoringTechniques.name: Preserve Whole Object
refactoringTechniques.description: Instead of passing several values from an object as separate parameters, pass the entire object.

refactoringTechniques.name: Replace Parameter with Method Call
refactoringTechniques.description: If a parameter can be obtained by calling a method, replace the parameter with the method call.

refactoringTechniques.name: Use Builder Pattern
refactoringTechniques.description: For complex object creation with many optional parameters.
